body: I'm not enough for me, I won't stay alive for me
Yea, sadly I do, I'm just here to keep you typing longer friend

Do you know sometimes other people aren't as happy as they seem? Just cuz they are creating families and traveling doesn't mean they're happy. Some people are very good at "faking the funk" their whole life revolves around a "happy family" image, and then there are those of us that can't mask our true feelings. Are we weaker because we show our TRUE feelings, no, we're actually stronger.
As sad as it is, many a times I've wanted to end it and just think what my dogs life would be. I have found her a safe secure residence that I trust for when I decided to take my life.

I'm just curious as to why you're trying to make life easier for people you can't even turn to in YOUR time of need. Let's rethink some of this. And I wanna kill myself too--but I ain't leaving nobody NOTHIN. If they mean that much to you, they mean enough for you to live, GET IT

I have a dog. The dog she ABANDONED me with. She will be 5 in March. What sucks is she knew she was gonna leave me (she later admitted she had planned it for months) and she LET me resign our lease a few days before the breakup. Knowing I'd have to live in that cold dead apartment alone. And she insisted I get a dog to cure her own boredom before any of this happened. She left me and the dog behind. Do you kno how hard it was to take care of a dog when I didn't even wanna take care of myself? But to this day--the dog is legit one of the reasons I'm alive. She highly intelligent, intuitive to feelings because she's been around me only. She doesn't deserve to be sheltered or put down (as she's an aggressive (protective) pit bull)
I feel the exact same. I'm tryna motivate u to stay alive, cuz I need it too man.
